At the time of the [[Coup on Pergitor|coup on Pergitor]], '''The Preceptor''' was the leader of the [[Church of Infinite Perception/Legends|Church of Infinite Perception]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pergitor]].<ref name="GG6">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref> Before reclaiming the world they had been exiled for 15 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the once strict government of the planet had become liberal following a revolution.<ref name="HNN 46>''{{HoloNetNewsWeb|46|regional/1337_4.html|Pergitor Coup Leaves Thousands Dead}}''</ref>
